summary: The Backrooms is a shared multiplayer survival RPG spanning Levels 0–8, Base Gamma and a debug room. Place simulations and authored cells assemble local environments; shared player, combat, NPC, loot, crafting and UI systems carry individual progression across them. Level 8's 9th Road is assembled from a Blender cave model plus interactive local systems; an offline kemono rig/garment conversion pipeline has also been added alongside the established critter character generators.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, containers, breakable furniture, shifting walls and hunters.

places/level1, places/level2, places/level3 + places/gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone, Utility Halls, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; camps, seeded layouts, hazards, agents, traders, generators, lifts and checkpoint.
places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office; office plan, residents, cubicle systems, fountains, vending, lift/stairs and Base Omega.
places/level5 (3D) - Terror Hotel; Main Hall, guest rooms, Beverly and Boiler rooms, rentals, mahjong, rat packs, Level 6 portal and Ines's goggles quest.
places/level6 (3D) - Lights Out; seeded dark concrete labyrinth, survivor notes/props, shifting wall, auditory hazards, hounds and Smiler; stairs link Levels 5 and 7.
places/level7 (3D) - Thalassophobia; flooded Floating House, Seawatch, Fort Surrender and its worshippers, sea-floor/seamount, camps, diving bell and inert Level 9 hatch.

places/level8 (3D) - Cave Systems / 9th Road; colliding karst tube with lake, flood cavern and scramble ledges, Hyperspace Lane, spider nest/Broodmother, boiling tar dredge, survivor camp, radio and exit glow.
places/debug (3D) - debug room; Level 8's separate config supplies dark fog/sky, no terrain or moon, deep reverb and its own spawn.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, player actions, player template and HUD renderer; Backspace opens the main menu.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain; locomotion precedes movement and gameplay handlers run before critter, main-menu and view3.

templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position, including seated/talk views and collision-limited third person; scripts/view3.js toggles player.state.tp.
places/<place>/sim.js + config.yaml/cells - place setup and authored placements; sims build local layouts, manage respawns/regrowth and tick local behavior.
scripts/ui.js and *-ui.js renderers - HUD and overlays, including main menu, wardrobe, mahjong, loot, talk/trade, build, stats, craft and OS panels.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - local player menu and Continue/Character actions; fresh profiles enter creator, returning profiles the menu; menu tick supplies hidden-player camera backdrop.
places/level7/config.yaml + scripts/look-level7.js + scripts/terrain7.js - Level 7 atmosphere, ocean/islands and local setup; sim delegates house and fort details to shared Level 7 builders.
places/level8/sim.js + art/level8/build.py - Level 8 assembler and Blender cave-road generator; art/kemono/build.py is a separate offline rig-and-garment conversion entry, not a runtime place system.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading; player and M.E.G. NPC chains run it before their controllers; scripts/lib/body3.js supplies weapon animation and rowing IK.
scripts/lib/maze.js, scripts/lib/level1.js/level2.js + data - shared per-level grids/layouts for sims, geometry and gameplay; maze.js also names Level 7 zones.
scripts/lib/level3.js + Level 3 data + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings, routes and hazards used by geometry, sim, creatures and visits.
scripts/lib/level4.js, level5.js, level6.js + scripts/lib/level6path.js - office/hotel plans and sanity, Level 6 grid and path queries shared by geometry, simulation and player behavior.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims and Level 7 fauna.
scripts/lib/clothes.js, scripts/lib/critter-model.js + face/model data, and scripts/mat-cloth.js - seeded NPC/player looks, rendered critter bodies and garment patterns.
scripts/lib/craft.js + scripts/lib/data/craft.yml - recipe readiness, batch capacity and category list shared by craft actions and UI; includes Level 8 resource recipes.
scripts/lib/personality.js + scripts/lib/address.js - seeded temperament, dialogue style/reactions and how NPCs address players; reused by talk.js, npc-talk.js and meg-agent.js.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; Level 4/5 also lay; Level 7 exports breakables(FY,PY); Level 8 exports cadence and tick.
scripts/l8-life.js - updateSchedule, update; scripts/l8-use.js - ears, onTriggerEnter, back.
scripts/lib/personality.js - TEMPERS, temperOf, lineFor, styleOf, TEMPER_STATS, TEMPER_NERVE; scripts/lib/address.js - termFor, addressFor, saysName.
scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf and shared loot/remains helpers; Level 8 resolves to the Level 2 item pool.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js - keepPeople, every, RESPAWN_MS; scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - RESPAWN_MS, mayReturn, firstLay.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/level2.js, level4.js, level5.js, level6.js - plan/grid constants and queries; scripts/lib/level6path.js - cellAt, cellCenter, isWalkable, stepToward6.
scripts/terrain7.js - ISLES, heightAt, materialAt; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - faceFill, faceMorph, rewear, toMesh and model helpers.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, kills/deaths, heat, combat and fishing rewards; owns look/clothing data.
scripts/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates sheet and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - craft UI state, recipe actions, payout redemption and hunger/thirst drain; validates through shared recipeStatus/maxMakes.
scripts/horde.js - player horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing and spawned creatures carry horde owner id.
scripts/build.js + player.js - player scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.
scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js own interaction/focus/loot and sit state; scripts/lockpick.js owns pick state and pins; seats own occupancy.

scripts/talk.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - NPC dialogue memory/rapport/shop/follow state; meg-agent owns routines, temperament-shaped attributes/nerve, loadout, combat, fear/want, cover and corpse inspection.

places/level8/sim.js owns Level 8 build version, camp initialization and shared regrow deadlines; l8-life.js session data owns flood/spider/boss/tar/hazard timing; l8-use.js writes player payouts, quest flags, effects and route progress.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered handlers: locomotion before movement; interact, grab, rest, mahjong, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, OS, lockpick and horde before critter, main-menu and view3.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js presented yaw/pitch and eye position; view3.js writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
world.config.yaml Backspace → scripts/main-menu.js toggles menu; mmenu play/char and scripts/ui.js render menu/creator; menu hides player and supplies ctx.view.camera backdrop.
Level 0 exit and paired doors/lifts → scripts/level-door.js arrival markers/state.to; place sims add markers and player.js selects safe spawn/checkpoints after death.
scripts/player.js writes state.xfer and xpPop → scripts/ui.js transition card and XP display; lvlPrompt prompts K and stats.js clears it when opening the sheet.

interact.js on NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js submits choices/text/trade → talk.js and NPC ears; dialogue stores per-player NPC memory/rapport, and follow intent → meg-agent.js companion pursuit/return.

talk.js/NPC dialogue → address.js and personality.js → seeded personal address and temperament-specific lines; talk.js detects a name introduction and stores named memory; meg-agent.js applies temperament stat/nerve shaping.
places/level7/sim.js lays Level 7 and l7-use.js handles its props; diving-bell press → ctx.cross('level8#l8-from-l7').
places/level8/sim.js lays the 9th Road; lake trigger with state.to → level7#l7-from-l8; l8-from-l7/l8-from-camp markers feed player checkpoint selection.

scripts/l8-use.js E/trigger handlers → lake route, one-time crawl loop, asphalt-glow return-to-camp, Carla/kazoo and camp board; altar heals/restores sanity, dredge pays out pitch/loot, radio cycles survey logs.
Level 8 fungus/cocoon/seep handlers and breakables → player.state.payout → scripts/craft.js redemption; sim.js records missing DEFS deadlines and respawns caps, silk cocoons, seeps and stone.
scripts/l8-life.js 0.1s update → flood/drowning, guides, regenerating cave spiders and Broodmother/remains, articulated tar hands/pull/damage and distant rumble/scream effects.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures, red-zone variants, flicker-wall details and local sound/light state; Level 5 cells include portal and quest props.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + level4-geo.js, level4-detail-geo.js, l4-prop-geo.js and look-level4.js - office structure, details, varied props and post-processing share the Level 4 plan; Level 7 has dedicated room/ocean geo.
scripts/l4-office.js + l4-office-geo.js - cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambience, tasks and rewards.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC rounds, talk, faction, role, voice, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies shared combat behavior.
scripts/lib/craft.js + data/craft.yml - shared category/recipe handling; category, scrap cost, skill, bench requirement, batch size and item family vary by recipe, including Level 8 cave materials.

scripts/lib/npc-talk.js + shops.yml/talk.yml + scripts/lib/personality.js/address.js - dialogue, trade, seeded temperament and address vary by persona, stock, rapport and player name; Backdollars are the trade currency.

places/level8/sim.js + scripts/l8-life.js + scripts/l8-use.js - road stations share coordinate interpolation, while harvest regrowth, flood traversal, boss/hazards, caches, camp interactions, quests and payouts vary by station/encounter.
art/critter-cute/build.py + scripts/lib/data/critter-models.yml - species and sex select distinct heads/body meshes; snout and markings vary by species, consumed by shared critter-model.js rendering.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m; Level 1 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 26×26 at 4 m; Level 4 is 64×64 m with 8 m offices; Level 5 is 96×60 m; Level 6 is 27×41 cells at 1.8 m and 2.4 m high.

Level 6 builtV is 3; moving trigger/prop sites must match scripts/lib/level6.js plan(), its shift wall toggles only outside 7 m, and it suppresses/destroys the flashlight/torch on entry. Keep stair markers l6-from-l7/l7-from-l6 paired.
Level 5 Ines quest progress is player.state.nvgQ (1 asked, 2 case, 3 goggles, 4 complete); the north portal leads to Level 6 and its auxiliary bulkhead remains welded shut.

Level 7 terrain centers are (0,0), (46,-120), (-70,-95), (4,8); floating-house model is visual-only around its own colliding walls. builtV=22 clears l7x-/l7h- details; hatch at (-150, terrain, 0) is inert; keep paired Level 8 arrival markers.

Level 8 sim rebuild gate is V=9; road P(s,side,up) interpolates scripts/lib/data/level8.yml stations, regrow delays are seconds, and spawned l8 IDs must stay coordinated with rebuild cleanup/DEFS. The Blender road model is colliding; spider/boss model path is shared by sim and l8-life.

art/kemono/build.py converts sex-specific rigged base + old critter body into kemono-<sex>.glb and refits old garments; preserve -Y facing, Hips at 0.64 m, critter bone names and garment skin weights. The uploaded kemono-female-rig, kemono-male-rig and base-male assets are not referenced by runtime files yet.
